title: Mobile Python editing and console improvements
summary: Add functional touch coding keys, a bounded CodeMirror surface, cursor feedback, keyboard-aware layout and console output following.

changes.detail: Optional accessible accessory keys for tab, indent/outdent, cursor movement, undo/redo, paired delimiters and Python symbols. Added cursor position and console follow control.

Larger default editor text, readable gutters, bounded editor scrolling, keyboard-specific editor height, batched viewport updates, panel scroll memory, input focus and reduced-motion-aware running feedback.

Remove Android double keyboard avoidance because MainActivity already uses adjustResize. Disable autocorrect in code and input; preserve CodeMirror selection across panel switches. Preserve existing isolated Python execution and cancellation architecture.

validation.name: Focused and full validation
validation.detail: Pending rebuilt mobile bundle, automated tests, lint, typecheck, browser interaction/layout checks and web export. Physical Android and iOS keyboard validation remains required.
